content: {"praised":["Unique look at life aboard Titanic across all classes.","Dramatic, edge‑of‑your‑seat excitement beyond the sinking.","Multiple intertwined stories with their own secrets.","Strong acting and well‑written script.","Excellent set design and production quality."],"criticized":["Numerous factual errors and goofs about the ship.","Characters speak inappropriately for 1912.","Story feels dull and unengaging.","Too much soap‑opera, little factual storyline.","Overall disappointing performance and pacing."]}
